messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@dataforge.ai>, partner-integrations@dataforge.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner sandpit orchestration & co-sell readiness — DataForge sandbox

Hi Nora / DataForge team,

Great to connect last week — excited about teaming up on the preview co-sell for your new analytics connector. To make the marketplace listing and joint demos predictable, we want to stand up a short-lived "partner sandpit" environment we can both use for testing and trial runs.

High-level asks:
- Can DataForge provision a tenant (or service account) we can access for integration smoke tests?
- Primary test matrix: auth flow (OIDC + API key), sizing for 4 concurrent demo sessions, and sample dataset ingestion latency.
- Goal dates: sandbox ready by Wed 20 May; first joint demo 28 May.

Ben, Olga, Vivek: can you review the attached architecture diagram and call out anything blocking from Redwood side (network, billing SKUs, or co-sell SKU mapping)? I attached an initial playbook and a MAP (minimal action plan) timeline.

Nora — please confirm the contact who will own sandpit provisioning and whether you need a Redwood-side RSA key or service account.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123 | marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: sandbox-architecture-diagram.png, co-sell-playbook-v1.pdf, MAP_timeline_sheet.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Nora Patel <nora.patel@dataforge.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner sandpit orchestration & co-sell readiness — DataForge sandbox

Thanks Marissa — quick tech notes from my side:

- Networking: we can accept egress from a DataForge-managed IP range; Olga and I will share the temporary allowlist range by EOD Monday. If you prefer a VPN peering model we can scope that but it pushes timeline ~3 business days.
- Auth: OIDC handshake tested with our dev tenant; for the sandpit a short-lived service account + scoped API key works fine. Please do not send prod keys.
- Capacity: for 4 concurrent demo sessions, suggest reserved Dedicated pool: 2x A100-equivalent slots with request timeout set to 60s. Vivek — can you confirm cost delta vs burst mode?

Blocking items for us:
1) Access to a DataForge test tenant and a set of representative sample datasets (CSV + parquet)
2) Sandbox billing contact for temporary capacity provisioning
3) Any security questionnaire items you expect us to pre-fill for the listing (SOC 2 artifacts we can provide).

I’ll add suggested allowlist CIDRs and a proposed autoscale config in a follow-up note.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Partner Ops 
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa / Ben — thanks, this plan looks good. Quick answers:

- Sandbox owner: I’ll assign our Integration Lead, Carlos Mendes (carlos@dataforge.ai). He’ll provision a sandbox tenant and create a short-lived service account (48h tokens) for your team.
- Datasets: we can drop a representative 10GB sample bucket (CSV + parquet) into a pre-signed S3 bucket — Carlos will share the link.
- Security: we’ll accept a short SOC 2 evidence pack. If you can pre-fill the marketplace security checklist, it speeds approval.

Timeline constraints: Carlos is on PTO Tue–Wed; he can create the tenant on Thu 21 May. If that slips, we can do a light demo using our non-prod hosted preview (but it won’t exercise full ingestion).

I’ll loop Carlos in now.

Best,
Nora
Nora Patel | Head of GTM Partnerships | DataForge Labs

Team — summary and next steps (action items):

1) Carlos (DataForge) to provision tenant and post a pre-signed S3 link by Thu 21 May. Nora confirmed Carlos will own.
2) Ben to send allowlist CIDRs and suggested autoscale config by Mon 18 May EOD — Ben: note that we should prefer the Dedicated pool recommendation for predictable demo latency.
3) Olga to prepare the minimal SOC 2 evidence pack and the marketplace security checklist draft (we’ll pre-fill as much as possible).
4) Vivek to estimate cost delta for reserved vs burst capacity and confirm if a short promo commit is feasible for trial customers.
5) Marissa to open HubSpot task and update DF-4571 with MAP milestones + attach the playbook.

Can everyone confirm they’re good with these owners? If so I’ll schedule a 30-minute technical punchlist call Fri 22 May (30 mins) to run through the allowlist and ingestion steps.

Thanks — will keep the DataForge thread live and copy any updates to the HubSpot deal.

Marissa
